--- Page 5 --- ss book helong to t:ovt R u t h AGANCHENGANI "Na'a jechi re'a, uchinan angaba re'gen; Na'a jeo waltua, unon angaba waltugen. Nang'ni manderangan angniba manderang; Nang'ni Isolan angniba Isol ong'gen.
Jeo na'a sia unon angaba sigen.
Aro gopako man'chongmotgen.
Siana agre nang'ko aro angko ekgrikatodo, Jihova angna indake ,aro una bateba dakchina." Ia aganani ning'tubegipa ka'saani aro on'kangani kattarang ong'achim.
Aiao! Ruthni segipana ka'saania mairongpila- chim !
Un siangahaoba, uni ka'tongo ua tangkame dongengachim.
Ong'jaode buchu- ma Naomi una maichim?
Ia sigiminna aro.
tanggipana ka'saanian,  da'nang ! Rajani demechik, Rani Ruthko a'bao mi kolame cha'aona kingking ga'akataha!
Bisong niosani dukko , agansokpilja- hachim.
Ianan Naomi indake agdnpilaha.
" Anga bang'amung ong'katangaha, Jakari angko pilbaataha; Jihova angni kosako, sakki ong'a Shaddai angna namgijako on'beaha.
--- Page 6 --- RUTH Naomi ine angko mingnabeaha, Mara (Ka'gipa) mingskaboaha. Oe, Ruth duk chakaha, indiba uni ning'tubegipa ka'saani aro on'kangani nama gunranga Isol on'skaaha.
Pilak namana man'skaani aro pattiani gnang; indiba namgijana kenani aro sao dongsoi.
Nibo!
pilak manderang aro me'aparang aganaha: "Chingan sakkirang ong'a. Israelni ma'chongko rikgipa sakgni Rahel aro Lea gita, Jihova nang'ni nokona re'bagipa Me'chikko ong'atchina.
Na'a Ephratha bilakgipa ong'bo.
Bethlehemo mingsinggipa ongbo., Ia songjinmni me'aparang una pat.
tianiko on'e' sganaha gitan Ruthna ong'- bebeaha; maina Boaz uchi Obedko ba'- aha.
Obed Jesseko ba'aha; Jesse Daudko ba'aha aro Daudni ma'chongo a'gilsakko JOKATGIPA Kristo atchiaha. Gilbert Marak Tura.
